origin: New Codex-authored native encounter under Martin's portfolio direction, using the seed's small two-phase arena objective.
missing_source: VeuPartido_UnityStarter_v0.0.47.zip is a historical breadcrumb, not present in this checkout. No Unity migration or recovered code is claimed.
technology: Godot 4.6.3 standard / GDScript / CharacterBody2D and StaticBody2D / native Canvas rendering and Controls.
inspected_but_not_transferred: P10's preserved COMBAT_FORMULAS.csv and RM_COMBAT_RUNTIME.rb contain random accuracy/crit and level-scaled mitigation. They are not used by this deterministic real-time encounter; the related transfer remains a candidate.
accepted_differences: New 2D desktop trial, original Bell Warden, blade/seal/resolve/ward interactions and original procedural geometry; not restored historical 3D gameplay or franchise characters.
One enemy with three locked patterns, phase-two echo, pressure/opening tradeoffs and actual victory/defeat. No 20-boss catalogue, damage taxonomy, crafting or campaign claim.
Native source and built PCK are delivered. PCK requires Godot; no standalone platform executable, Unity editor or .NET compilation is claimed.
media_origin: All runtime visual geometry and UI are authored in arena.gd; preview.png is an actual Godot framebuffer capture from scripted play. No external image, font file or audio is imported.
engine_license: Godot is MIT-licensed: https://godotengine.org/license/ . No engine binary is redistributed in the repository.
quality_boundary: Engine execution and implementing-agent visual/strategy review, not human input, audience approval or commercial validation.
